# Project Atlas — Staffing Plan

## Leadership

Priya Raman leads Project Atlas and reports to the VP of Platform. She chairs
the steering group and owns the delivery forecast.

## Workstream leads

Marcus Webb leads the reconciliation workstream and reports to Priya Raman.
Marcus came across from the Payments team and retains a dotted line to the
Payments engineering manager.

Aisha Okonkwo leads data quality and also reports to Priya Raman. Aisha owns the
historical invoice cleanup, which is currently the project's largest unstaffed
item.

## Secondments

Two engineers are seconded from Payments and one from Data Platform. The
Data Platform secondment ends in September and has not been extended.

## Contract support

Contract support was approved for the reconciliation workstream only. Marcus
Webb approves contractor timesheets for that workstream.
